zh: 四位伙伴和你，从第一顿饭开始。
en: You and four companions, starting with your first meal.

zh: 原世界会完整归档，人物与作品保留。
en: The old world will be archived intact. Characters and artwork stay with you.

zh: 正式开局 · 几乎空的岛，从生火吃饭开始
en: Standard · An almost empty island. Start with a fire and a meal.

zh: 展示开局 · 所有建筑已建好，看看小岛的样子
en: Showcase · Buildings ready, so you can explore island life.

zh: 当前进度保存失败，原世界保留，未重开。
en: Couldn't save your progress. Your world is safe; nothing was restarted.

zh: 原会话 ID 无效，未创建替代会话。
en: Invalid original conversation ID. No replacement conversation was created.

zh: 无法重开世界，原进度仍保留。
en: Couldn't restart. Your existing progress is safe.

zh: 存档属于另一地图模板，已保留原档及副本；请明确使用 --fresh-world 归档重开。
en: This save uses another map template. The original and a copy are safe. Use --fresh-world explicitly to archive and restart.

zh:
原世界属于旧地图，已保留原档与副本。
归档重开会重置世界进度，保留人物身份、外观作品和可编辑模板。
可选正式或展示开局；预置建筑不算玩家建设进度。
en:
Your world uses an older map. The original save and a copy are safe.
Restarting archives world progress but keeps identities, appearances and editable templates.
Choose Standard or Showcase. Preset buildings do not count as construction progress.

zh: 原会话绑定未能保存，下次需要重新指定。
en: Couldn't save the conversation binding. Specify it again next time.

zh: 这座岛留待以后航行探索。
en: We'll explore this island on a future voyage.
Click the ground to walk, or a tree to chop.

zh: 方向键 / 右键平移  ·  滚轮缩放
en: Arrow keys / Right-drag to pan · Wheel to zoom

zh: 点一块空地，摆放设施地基。
en: Choose an open spot for the facility foundation.

zh: 暂时不能发送，先等当前回应或检查连接。
en: Can't send right now. Wait for the current reply or check the connection.

zh: 这句话还没发送，先等当前回应。
en: This message hasn't been sent. Wait for the current reply.

zh: 旧进度文件无法读取，已保留原件供恢复。
en: Couldn't read the old progress file. The original is safe for recovery.

zh: 外观偏好暂时无法保存。
你当前使用的是非默认外观。若这是有意选择，可以保留；也可以先备份存档，再恢复默认外观。
en: You're using a different appearance. Keep it if you chose it, or back up the save and restore the default.

zh: 无法备份存档，外观未改变。
en: Couldn't back up the save. Your appearance hasn't changed.

zh: 已备份存档并恢复你的默认外观。
en: Save backed up and your default appearance restored.
Who would you like to talk to?

zh: 看看这位伙伴在哪里；只移动镜头，不改变任何人的行动。
en: Show where this companion is. Only the camera moves; nobody's actions change.

zh: 切换控制来源会暂停原工作；身份、物品和已完成进度保留。连接后发送消息才启动模型。
en: Changing control source pauses existing work. Identity, items and completed progress stay. Send a message to start the model.

zh: 原会话转接验证：复制后粘贴到绑定的 Codex 对话。此入口尚不会自动唤醒。
en: Manual relay check: paste into the bound Codex conversation. This entry does not wake it automatically.

zh: 使用独立的共享测试会话，保留当前原会话绑定。发消息才开始推理。
en: Use a separate shared test conversation, keeping the original binding. Reasoning starts only after you send a message.

zh: 本地规则驱动闲逛与休息，不调用模型；任务和真正的对话优先。
en: Local rules handle wandering and rest without model calls. Work and real conversations take priority.

zh: 预设的场景短句，气泡标记为日常；不会代替真正的 AI 回复。
en: Preset scene lines marked as daily chatter. They never replace a real AI response.

zh: 附近的她会用预设短句回应，不发起模型请求。
en: A nearby companion replies with a preset line. No model request is made.
Chat, or ask for a hand…

zh: 尚未连接模型；可招呼她、邀请活动，或说：
en: has no model connection yet. Say hello, invite them, or try:

zh: 她正在群聊中回应，请先完成或停止那边的对话。
en: They're replying in group chat. Finish or stop that conversation first.

zh: 上一条消息还未结束或队列已满，输入已保留。
en: The previous message is still running or the queue is full. Your input is safe.

zh: 当前没有可接收群消息的 AI，输入已保留。
en: No connected AI can receive this group message right now. Your input is safe.

zh: 对所有已接入的 AI 说…
未连接模型：可招呼、集合，或说“帮我种萝卜”
en: No model connected: say hello, gather companions, or ask “help me plant turnips”

zh: 请先用主角手里的鱼烧烤。
en: Choose a fish you're holding first.

zh: 还没有建好的营火，鱼儿仍在手中。
en: No completed campfire yet. You're still holding the fish.
Return to the island to place this.

zh: 地基已放好，可选择建造者。
点左上角回到我的视角，再操作。
en: Return to your own view at the top left before acting.

zh: 请看看这块田并照料它。目标：
en: Please check and tend this field. Target:

zh: 请采这丛蘑菇并存进箱子。目标：
en: Please gather these mushrooms and store them. Target:

zh: 小树正在长大，先让它长一会儿。
en: This sapling is growing. Give it a little time.

zh: 请你砍这棵树，并把木材搬进箱子。目标：
en: Please chop this tree and store the wood. Target:

zh: 请你完成这座房子的下一施工阶段。目标：
en: Please complete the next construction stage of this house. Target:

zh: 请你把这堆木材收进箱子。目标：
en: Please store this pile of wood. Target:

zh: 先回答问题，工程和材料保留。
en: Answer the question first. The project and materials are safe.

zh: 等问题有了明确回答，再继续棋局。
en: Resume the game after the question has a clear answer.

zh: 的问题有了回答，再继续活动。

en: Waiting for your answer before farming continues.

zh: 等你回答后，再商量怎么继续。
en: After your answer, discuss how to continue.

zh: 房子盖好了，进去看看吧。
en: The house is finished. Come take a look!

zh: 进度保存失败，请检查磁盘空间。
en: Couldn't save progress. Check free disk space.

zh: 请先回到营火所在区域。
en: Return to the campfire's region first.

zh: 火边暂时没有能走到的空位。
en: No reachable space beside this fire right now.

zh: 日常设置暂时无法保存。

en: They'll only go after you confirm.

zh: 请在小屋内这个位置制作并摆放家具：
en: Please craft and place furniture at this spot inside the house:

zh: 点家具使用 · 布置小屋 · 门口回院子
en: Use furniture · Arrange room · Return to the yard at the door

zh: 小屋一点点有了我们的样子。
en: Little by little, this cottage feels like ours.

zh: %s · 连续伐木 · 已搬完 %s 棵 · 存入 %s 根木材
en: %s · Gathering wood · %s trees hauled · %s wood stored

zh: 玩家停止或调整棋手，先保留棋盘。
en: The player stopped or changed participants. Keep the board as it is.

zh: 伙伴正在回应或等你回答，稍后再邀请。
en: This companion is replying or awaiting your answer. Invite them later.

zh: 先回答伙伴的问题，或等这次回应结束。
en: Answer the companion's question, or wait for their reply to finish.

zh: 紧凑田垄 · 三套独立人物 · 一起生活的小院
en: Neat farm rows · Three independent characters · A courtyard to share

zh: 秋千 · 茶歇 · 林间舞台
en: Swings · Tea breaks · A woodland stage

zh: 配置已复制，居民已切到外部AI。游戏消息等待该客户端读取；不会启动原模型。
en: Configuration copied. This resident now uses external AI. Game messages wait for that client; the previous model won't start.

zh: 已返回原连接，原有会话记录保留；发送消息才连接。
en: Original connection restored. Conversation records stay. Send a message to connect.

zh: 共享测试伙伴：独立会话，发消息后自动回应。
en: Shared test companion: a separate conversation that replies automatically after your message.

zh: 已返回原来的对话连接。
en: Returned to the original dialogue connection.

zh: 先输入并发送一条游戏消息。
en: Write and send a game message first.

zh: 已复制；请粘贴到绑定的 Codex 对话。
en: Copied. Paste into the bound Codex conversation.

zh: 已选择模型连接，发消息才启动。
en: Model connection selected. Send a message to start it.

zh: 交给本地生活，原工作已暂停。
en: Back to local life. Previous work is paused.

zh: 模型接入（消息或主动事件）
模型接入（发消息才启动）
先结束这位居民的对话或回答问题，再安排工程。
en: Finish this resident's conversation or answer their question before assigning a project.

zh: 约定已取消；真实物资保留。
en: Promise cancelled. All real materials are safe.

zh: 点目标，交给这位伙伴商量。
en: Choose a target to discuss with this companion.

zh: 执行已安排的引擎任务

en: Heading to a shared favorite spot

zh: 主动思考 · 预算回合
等待回答或客户端处理
en: Waiting for a reply or client processing

zh: 等待外部 AI 读取或回复
en: Waiting for external AI to read or reply

zh: 已绑定 · 尚未确认连接
大家各自活动，随时可以招呼或集合。
en: Everyone is doing their own thing. Say hello or gather together any time.

zh: 砍过的林地重新长出小树苗。
en: Saplings are growing again where we chopped trees.

zh: 请看看建屋计划 %s，和我商量下一步。
en: Please check house-building plan %s and discuss our next step.

zh: %s尚未连接模型；可招呼她、邀请活动，或说：%s。
en: %s has no model connection yet. Say hello, invite them, or try: %s.
help me plant turnips, harvest the crops

zh: 等%s的问题有了回答，再继续活动。
en: Wait for an answer to %s's question before continuing.
